strengths_deep_dive:
In FY2024, MAPS demonstrated solid financial management by allocating <cite id="1">82.4% of expenses to program delivery</cite>. This performance beats the 75% industry standard, demonstrating that public contributions directly benefit community operations. This efficiency is backed by exceptional liquidity, as the organization carries <cite id="14">17.3 months of operating reserves</cite>, safeguarding critical social programs against revenue disruptions.

Beyond basic worship services, MAPS delivers high-impact social welfare. Through MAPS-MCRC, the organization provides direct relief including <cite id="2">emergency rental assistance for 500 families</cite> and operates a free medical clinic <cite id="6">for uninsured and low-income residents</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary:
The Muslim Association of Puget Sound (MAPS) is a major religious and social service institution in the Pacific Northwest. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="1">Total Revenue of $7,286,362</cite> to support the local Muslim community through prayer services, youth programming, and civic engagement. Beyond core religious functions, MAPS operates extensive social programs including the MAPS Community Services (MAPS-MCRC) relief division and a free medical clinic <cite id="6">that treats local patients in need</cite>.

Financial records from FY2024 demonstrate solid operational efficiency, with a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 82.4%</cite>. This exceeds the standard industry benchmark of 75%, ensuring that the majority of funds directly support community operations rather than administrative overhead. Furthermore, MAPS maintains significant financial stability, holding <cite id="14">17.3 months of working capital in reserve</cite>.

Community outreach efforts show significant local scale. Comprehensive social services <cite id="3">touched 175,000 lives in recent years</cite>, while educational initiatives enrol over <cite id="3">3,000 students across various programs</cite>. In emergency support, MAPS provided <cite id="2">food and gas assistance to 2,500 individuals</cite> and delivered <cite id="2">rental and utility assistance to 500 households</cite>. MAPS earns <cite id="14">an overall score of 86.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting strong accountability and organizational leadership.
